molecules.name: Melatonin
molecules.role: Pineal gland hormone signaling darkness; MT1/MT2 receptor agonist; circadian timer

molecules.name: Adenosine
molecules.role: Sleep pressure accumulation during wakefulness; A1/A2A receptor agonist; caffeine's target

molecules.name: Ghrelin
molecules.role: Hunger hormone from stomach; elevated by sleep deprivation; drives hyperphagia

molecules.name: Leptin
molecules.role: Satiety hormone from adipocytes; reduced by sleep deprivation; nocturnal peak

molecules.name: Growth Hormone (GH)
molecules.label_th: ฮอร์โมนการเจริญเติบโต
molecules.role: 70-80% daily secretion during first SWS; lipolysis, protein synthesis

molecules.name: Cortisol
molecules.role: HPA stress hormone; normally low at night; elevated by sleep deprivation

molecules.name: Magnesium (Mg²⁺)
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียม
molecules.role: GABA-A cofactor; NMDA blocker; HIOMT cofactor for melatonin synthesis

molecules.name: L-Theanine
molecules.label_th: แอล-ธีอะนีน
molecules.role: Alpha brain wave inducer; GABA/NMDA modulation; relaxation without sedation

molecules.name: Caffeine
molecules.role: Adenosine receptor antagonist; blocks A1/A2A; half-life 5-7h; masks sleep pressure

molecules.name: Glycine
molecules.role: NMDA receptor co-agonist; peripheral vasodilation for temperature drop; sleep onset support
